 Emlyn Begley
 Most recent Most popular HITS THE WOODWORK published at 66 mins 66 mins 
 Newcastle 0-1 Everton 
 Newcastle's best chance by a gazillion miles. The referee checks his watch to see if this has crossed the line but it has not. 
 Yoane Wissa glances the ball on to Anthony Elanga at the far post. He shoots and it hits Jordan Pickford and the post and spins on the goalline without crossing it.

 Newcastle 0-1 Everton 
 Newcastle send on Sean Steur and Yoane Wissa for Nico Gonzalez and Joe Willock.

 This Newcastle side are so static they’ve all been given parking tickets.
 Craig, Cardiff 
 I like Matthias Jaissle and desperately want him to succeed at my beloved Newcastle, but this is so far, one of the most embarrassing performances I've ever witnessed!
 Callum, Braintree

 Post published at 63 mins 63 mins 
 Newcastle 0-1 Everton 
 Another save from Lukas Hornicek, this time to get an arm to Jake O'Brien's downwards header from a corner.

 Post published at 62 mins 62 mins 
 Newcastle 0-1 Everton 
 Image source, Getty Images Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall, in all kinds of space, curls in a nice shot from 20 yards out which Lukas Hornicek palms over the bar.

 Newcastle 0-1 Everton 
 Everton make a mess of clearing a Newcastle cross and Fabian Schar hammers a shot wide.
 Schar had looked set to come off with injury after that goal but has played on.

 Newcastle 0-1 Everton 
 Anthony Elanga blasts in a shot from long range which is blocked by the head of James Garner, who sits down and needs the physios on.

 Newcastle fans want to see a plan published at 21:16 GMT 21:16 GMT 
 Newcastle 0-1 Everton 
 Matthew Raisbeck 
BBC Radio Newcastle commentator 
 Image source, Getty Images You can hear desperation from the stands, they just want to see something. 
 They want to see a plan and an idea but you can tell confidence is not high.

 Newcastle 0-1 Everton

 Newcastle 0-1 Everton 
 Everton defender Jarrad Branthwaite's header is tipped over by Lukas Hornicek.
 Some pretty panicky defending from Newcastle from the resulting corner.

 Newcastle 0-1 Everton

 Matthias Jaissle = Steve McClaren with nice trainers.
No hope, no organisation and no signs of what is being worked on in training.

 Newcastle 0-1 Everton 
 No immediate reaction from Newcastle. In fact Everton are pushing for a second. And they have a corner.
